name: Addle
source:
Addle is an angel from Flaithis, and is the leader of Lugh's imperial guards. He is a noble-minded character who puts on a very serious front and won't tolerate injustice or unreasonableness. However, on the inside he is very passionate and has a serious romantic attitude towards love. Addle's chivalrous knight-like behavior can lead to a refreshing, romantic love.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/fragrance/fragrance.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
